title: 36 Hours in Galena, Ill.
abstract: THE lead mines and the steamboats are long gone, not to mention Ulysses S. Grant. The Galena River itself has filled with silt to become a narrow stream. But Galena cherishes what does remain from its 19th-century glory years: stunning 19th-century houses and a downtown that Grant would still recognize. Page 5.
